text: Nurses log in using existing hospital single sign-on credentials without creating new accounts
Display patient name and ID from OmniCare within two seconds of patient selection, with clear error message if OmniCare is unreachable
Allow nurses to enter a ward note once and save it simultaneously to OmniCare and queue it for the ward spreadsheet
Show nurses a confirmation message indicating note saved in OmniCare and pending spreadsheet update until both are confirmed
Automatically push all final notes to the ward spreadsheet at 7:30 AM daily without manual intervention
Format the ward spreadsheet so each note is clearly labeled with patient name, time of entry, and nurse’s name
Ensure the ward spreadsheet is saved and shared automatically by 7:30 AM each day for ward managers to view
Allow finance team to import a consistent CSV version of the weekly ward spreadsheet with all notes present, dated, and without duplicates or blanks
Retry failed spreadsheet writes at the next scheduled run and keep notes marked as pending until successful
Alert IT immediately on any failed write to OmniCare or the spreadsheet and show nurses clear messages about save status
Prevent nurses from retrying failed saves themselves; they only see warnings and report issues to IT
Replace corrected notes in the ward spreadsheet at the next scheduled run to maintain data accuracy
Maintain audit logs of all access and changes to patient notes in compliance with NHS DSPT standards
Encrypt all patient data both in transit and at rest, hosted on UK-based AWS UK South cloud servers
Support up to 24 nurses across three wards with capacity for around 10 simultaneous users without performance degradation
Operate exclusively on hospital Windows 10 desktop kiosks with Internet Explorer 11 compatibility, disallowing personal device access
Provide a clear count of total notes expected per shift at the top of the ward spreadsheet for ward manager verification
Show nurses a green confirmation message within two seconds after saving a note, including patient name, time, and nurse name
If OmniCare save fails, show nurses a clear failure message, do not queue note for spreadsheet, and alert IT
Automatically handle login to the shared Excel file on SharePoint using a hospital service account with read/write access
